'''Baerin''' is an Aiel woman who was a [[Maiden of the Spear]] before she married. She now has a daughter training to be a [[Wise One]].

When [[Mera]] claims that a chief should be handled the same way as a husband, Baerin replies with a laugh, saying that that would be a good way to have a [[roofmistress]] lay her knife at your feet and declare a feud.
